Hi there,

I need some help, I reg my daughter to get her birth certi and they adviced me to go to the post office to pick up a form that will reg her for benefits .. I went to two different Post Offices and none of them had any clue .. can someone help? Did anyone reg their newborns for any benefits (I am thinking about the £10 odd per week or something similar).

I understand that not all are entitled for benefits but I am guessing that there are still some benefits for all children ..

Thanks,
